```{=html}
<style>
.cyclotron-portrait {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 330px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 28px;
  width: min(1460px, 100%);
  height: 500px;
  margin: 0.15rem auto 0;
  color: #f2f2f2;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(20, 34, 54, 0.62);
}

.cyclotron-portrait-control label {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  font-size: 0.78em;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-control output {
  min-width: 3.2em;
  color: #ffb04f;
  text-align: right;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-control input[type="range"] {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: #ffad5c;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-readout {
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  color: #d7e5f5;
  font-size: 0.62em;
  line-height: 1.32;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-readout strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(3, 13, 28, 0.72);
}

.cyclotron-portrait-grid {
  stroke: rgba(126, 184, 235, 0.12);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-axis {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.58);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-contour {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(154, 184, 211, 0.34);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-current {
  fill: rgba(78, 161, 255, 0.12);
  stroke: #4ea1ff;
  stroke-width: 4;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-radius {
  stroke: #ffad5c;
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-dot {
  fill: #ffad5c;
  stroke: #ffffff;
  stroke-width: 2.5;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-label {
  fill: #f2f2f2;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 23px;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.cyclotron-portrait-muted {
  fill: #aebed0;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 18px;
}

</style>

<div class="cyclotron-portrait" data-cyclotron-portrait>
  <div class="cyclotron-portrait-controls">
    <div class="cyclotron-portrait-control">
      <label>
        <span>Поперечная энергия, E⊥/E₀</span>
        <output data-portrait-energy>1,00</output>
      </label>
      <input data-portrait-energy-input type="range" min="0.45" max="2.00"
             step="0.01" value="1.00" aria-label="Поперечная энергия">
    </div>

    <div class="cyclotron-portrait-control">
      <label>
        <span>Магнитное поле, B/B₀</span>
        <output data-portrait-field>1,00</output>
      </label>
      <input data-portrait-field-input type="range" min="0.70" max="1.50"
             step="0.01" value="1.00" aria-label="Магнитное поле">
    </div>

    <div class="cyclotron-portrait-readout">
      <div><strong>Полуось по Q:</strong> ∝ √E⊥/B</div>
      <div><strong>Полуось по P:</strong> ∝ √E⊥</div>
      <div><strong>Фазовая площадь:</strong> 2πJ</div>
      <div><strong>J/J₀:</strong> <span data-portrait-action>1,00</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <svg class="cyclotron-portrait-svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 505"
       role="img" aria-label="Фазовый портрет циклотронного движения">
    <g aria-hidden="true">
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="80" y1="95" x2="940" y2="95"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="80" y1="175" x2="940" y2="175"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="80" y1="335" x2="940" y2="335"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="80" y1="415" x2="940" y2="415"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="190" y1="45" x2="190" y2="460"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="350" y1="45" x2="350" y2="460"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="670" y1="45" x2="670" y2="460"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-grid" x1="830" y1="45" x2="830" y2="460"></line>

      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-axis" x1="70" y1="255" x2="950" y2="255"></line>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-axis" x1="510" y1="465" x2="510" y2="35"></line>

      <g data-portrait-contours></g>
      <ellipse class="cyclotron-portrait-current" data-portrait-current
               cx="510" cy="255" rx="180" ry="110"></ellipse>
      <line class="cyclotron-portrait-radius" data-portrait-radius
            x1="510" y1="255" x2="690" y2="255"></line>
      <circle class="cyclotron-portrait-dot" data-portrait-dot
              cx="690" cy="255" r="10"></circle>

      <text class="cyclotron-portrait-label" x="955" y="246">Q</text>
      <text class="cyclotron-portrait-label" x="525" y="45">P</text>
      <text class="cyclotron-portrait-muted" x="735" y="76">H⊥(Q,P)=E⊥</text>
      <text class="cyclotron-portrait-muted" x="735" y="106">серые линии: разные E⊥</text>
    </g>
  </svg>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  function initialize(root) {
    if (root.dataset.cyclotronPortraitReady === "true") return;
    root.dataset.cyclotronPortraitReady = "true";

    const energyInput = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-energy-input]");
    const fieldInput = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-field-input]");
    const energyOutput = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-energy]");
    const fieldOutput = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-field]");
    const actionOutput = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-action]");
    const contourGroup = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-contours]");
    const current = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-current]");
    const radius = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-radius]");
    const dot = root.querySelector("[data-portrait-dot]");
    const centerX = 510;
    const centerY = 255;
    const energyLevels = [0.50, 0.85, 1.20, 1.55, 1.90];
    const contours = energyLevels.map(() => {
      const ellipse = document.createElementNS(NS, "ellipse");
      ellipse.setAttribute("class", "cyclotron-portrait-contour");
      ellipse.setAttribute("cx", centerX);
      ellipse.setAttribute("cy", centerY);
      contourGroup.appendChild(ellipse);
      return ellipse;
    });
    const start = performance.now();

    function radii(energy, field) {
      return {
        q: 180 * Math.sqrt(energy) / field,
        p: 110 * Math.sqrt(energy)
      };
    }

    function format(value) {
      return value.toFixed(2).replace(".", ",");
    }

    function updateStatic() {
      const energy = Number(energyInput.value);
      const field = Number(fieldInput.value);
      const selected = radii(energy, field);

      energyOutput.value = format(energy);
      energyOutput.textContent = format(energy);
      fieldOutput.value = format(field);
      fieldOutput.textContent = format(field);
      actionOutput.textContent = format(energy / field);

      current.setAttribute("rx", selected.q.toFixed(2));
      current.setAttribute("ry", selected.p.toFixed(2));

      contours.forEach((ellipse, index) => {
        const contour = radii(energyLevels[index], field);
        ellipse.setAttribute("rx", contour.q.toFixed(2));
        ellipse.setAttribute("ry", contour.p.toFixed(2));
      });
    }

    function draw(now) {
      if (!document.body.contains(root)) return;

      const slide = root.closest("section");
      if (!slide || slide.classList.contains("present")) {
        const energy = Number(energyInput.value);
        const field = Number(fieldInput.value);
        const selected = radii(energy, field);
        const theta = 0.85 * (now - start) / 1000;
        const x = centerX + selected.q * Math.cos(theta);
        const y = centerY - selected.p * Math.sin(theta);

        dot.setAttribute("cx", x.toFixed(2));
        dot.setAttribute("cy", y.toFixed(2));
        radius.setAttribute("x2", x.toFixed(2));
        radius.setAttribute("y2", y.toFixed(2));
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }

    energyInput.addEventListener("input", updateStatic);
    fieldInput.addEventListener("input", updateStatic);
    updateStatic();
    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function initializeAll() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-cyclotron-portrait]").forEach(initialize);
  }

  initializeAll();
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeAll, {once: true});
})();
</script>
```
